# The path ahead is shown from what the project is for

- **record of** what it intends to become
- **Status:** In progress (the end-state of q-0037.0019's accepted `Where it stands`; first slice minted 2026-10-23)
- **Type:** HITL
- **Minted:** 2026-10-23
- **Answers:** [q-0037.0019](../questions/q-0037.0019-how-is-the-path-ahead-found-and-shown-the-guesses-held-as-questions-each-weighed-against-the-three-roots-and-the-next-shown-with-its-unit-as-the-installed.md)
- **Outcome:** The person sees, at every session's start and whenever they ask, which questions are in work against the cap, which the cap held back, which candidates stand at the next boundary and why, and how the three roots balance; what enters work is their word at a boundary, never the last idea said.

## Parent

[q-0037.0019](../questions/q-0037.0019-how-is-the-path-ahead-found-and-shown-the-guesses-held-as-questions-each-weighed-against-the-three-roots-and-the-next-shown-with-its-unit-as-the-installed.md),
whose `Where it stands` the user accepted on 2026-10-23. This ticket is that picture's end-state;
its children are the slices, the first carved the same day. The question keeps the argument, the
discoveries and the open parts: the weighing, the time-axis picture, the ring mark (deferred as
q-0037.0019.0001), the unit of work across methods.

## What to build

The pathfinder as the accepted picture states it: the agency over which question is worked next,
holding every open question of the store, reading them from the three roots, showing the path,
sending work to a purpose question when that root is thin, recommending at the rung of what gets
built next, the person deciding. The cap and the cadence are landed before it as L12 and Q1's ring
clause; this ticket makes them visible and counted, then adds the weighing and the picture, each
slice a complete pass from the records to what the person reads.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A person new to the tree reads one `/recall` and can say what is in work, what waits, what
      is next and why, without opening a file.
- [ ] A new idea said in conversation is placed and shown as a candidate, and enters work only at a
      boundary by the person's word, observed over a week of sessions.
- [ ] The three roots' balance is shown, and a thin purpose root is named as such.
- [ ] `/verify` passes against this ticket, its slices and the governing docs.

## Out of scope

The driver that runs the ring with outside judges — q-0037.0010.0002.0005.0001. The ring's rules
and the step-end choice — the practice mechanism's, q-0037.0010.0002.0005. A recipient's
pathfinder with its own method's unit — the seam in the ticket mechanism's doc, bound to
q-0037.0019.

# What the path shows at every recall

- **record of** what it intends to become
- **Status:** Ready
- **Type:** HITL
- **Minted:** 2026-10-23
- **Answers:** [q-0037.0019.0002](../questions/q-0037.0019.0002-what-does-the-agent-show-of-the-path-at-every-recall-and-on-request-the-count-in-work-against-the-cap-and-what-it-held-back-the-candidates-at-the-next-boundary-with.md)
- **Outcome:** At every `/recall`, and when the person asks where to go, the agent shows the path read from the records: how many questions are in work against the local cap and which the cap held back, the candidates at the next boundary each with its reason, and the three roots' open and ticketed counts.

## Parent

[01-0060 the-path-ahead-is-shown-from-what-the-project-is-for](./01-0060-the-path-ahead-is-shown-from-what-the-project-is-for.md),
the first of its slices: the picture read from what the records already hold, before any weighing.
The parent keeps the weighing, the time-axis drawing and the cadence's counting. Impact:
[in the question](../questions/q-0037.0019-how-is-the-path-ahead-found-and-shown-the-guesses-held-as-questions-each-weighed-against-the-three-roots-and-the-next-shown-with-its-unit-as-the-installed.md#impact-of-the-split-2026-10-23).

## What to build

- **The count in work.** Read from what exists: the owner tickets In progress and, for each, its
  question; against the cap the local file sets. Sessions' positions are not counted — the ring
  mark is deferred (q-0037.0019.0001) — so the count is the tickets' and says so.
- **What the cap held back.** The questions opened since the last boundary and not in work — the
  side questions — named, so a new idea is seen waiting rather than lost.
- **The candidates at the next boundary.** A handful, each with its reason in the person's words:
  the answer of the product document it serves and how much of that answer is built, read from
  the trace links and coverage; what waits on it, its strikes and the straw dogs bound to it; what
  it unlocks, read from `depends on`. Where a reason cannot be read, the candidate says so rather
  than inventing one. The queue's order stands and is not re-ranked; the candidates are read in it.
- **The roots' balance.** For each of the three roots: open questions, questions with a ticket.
  A purpose root with no ticket is named thin.
- **Where it is shown.** In `/recall`'s *What the person hears*, after where the work stands; and
  freeform, when the person asks where to go, the same picture. Under `debug=on` the script's
  output as well. The picture is computed by a script of the store, not by hand, so two sessions
  show the same path.
- **In a tree without rungs, trace links or a product document** the picture shows what exists and
  names what it cannot read; nothing fails.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A `/recall` in this tree shows the count of questions in work against the local cap, read
      from the tickets In progress, and names what the cap held back.
- [ ] It shows at most a handful of candidates at the next boundary, each with its reason read from
      the records, and says *unread* where a reason cannot be read.
- [ ] It shows the three roots' open and ticketed counts and names a thin root.
- [ ] Asked *where should we go* in conversation, the agent shows the same picture.
- [ ] The person reads one `/recall` and can say what is next and why without opening a file,
      read by the person.
- [ ] In a tree with no product document and no rungs, the picture shows what exists and nothing
      fails, tried on an empty install.
- [ ] `/verify` passes against this ticket, its RFC and the governing docs.

## Out of scope

The weighing — value, leverage, evidence under the person's weights — and the ordering of
candidates by it: the parent's later slice, after the cap and the cadence are watched. The
time-axis picture, now/next/later: the parent's. Counting sessions in the ring: q-0037.0019.0001,
deferred. Re-ranking the queue: never this ticket's; the order is the person's.

## architecture: responsibilities and the store
## Responsibilities

- `/maintain` holds four things in agreement at drift scope — docs to the meta-rules, docs to
  their implementation both ways, live records to their format, every fact to one home — and
  repairs under the repair policy; it handles straw dogs and determines eligibility
  for archive operations. Agreement over a landed slice is `/verify`'s.
- Supporting scripts enumerate artifacts and perform mechanical transformations. They do
  not invent completion evidence, decide architectural questions, or turn an arbitrary
  expiry condition into authority to execute code.
- `/align` owns unresolved decisions. `/verify` owns verification of delivered work against
  its ticket, RFC, governing documents and the project's verification set.
- A ticket's header owns its delivery state, and the queue the order of the work and its
  candidate; the live tickets are listed from their headers on request, never copied
  ([01-0011.0040](tickets/done/01-0011.0040-the-ticket-list-is-rendered-never-copied.md), the user,
  2026-10-10). Tickets and RFCs retain work decisions and evidence;
  the mechanism's [evidence record](mechanisms/maintain.evidence.md) retains observations
  that inform maintenance of the mechanism itself.

## Contract surfaces
### Question store

The store is shared by every session working in the tree; a position is one session's. An entry's
parts are written only by the script's calls, one per event; its body, the question's argument,
is written by hand, and every call keeps it as it found it
([decision 3](tickets/done/01-0011.0100.0020-open-issues-are-entries-of-the-store.md#decisions-landed-at-this-tickets-align)).
A write re-reads every entry it changes and refuses one that moved since it was read — a hand edit
included; detected interference is a failure, as in
[interruption and recovery](#interruption-and-recovery). A new question's id is the script's to
draw, and one another session took meanwhile is drawn again. An id says where the question sits —
a root `q-NNNN`, a child its parent's id and one more position — and stays true: a re-parent
renames the moved subtree in the same call, its files and every id and link to them across the
records under `docs/`, mechanically and without forwarding the old ids
([decision 6](tickets/done/01-0011.0100.0020-open-issues-are-entries-of-the-store.md#decisions-landed-at-this-tickets-align)).
A session's row is [the session mechanism](../.agents/mechanisms/session/session.md)'s: each
session writes its own and no other, so one write never refuses another's; a wake ends the silent
and removes the long ended, and a rename rewrites the ids a row names — the two writes to a row
not its own, each safe because a silent session has no write of its own to meet *(the user,
2026-10-10)*. A wholly closed subtree moves to `done/` with the mover in the `close` call that
finishes it; the maintainer's move is the sweep for what a closure left behind. A host's hook
delivers the window and registers the session under the host's steadiest id, and never fails
the host: a problem becomes a line of context. Everything else is
[the questions mechanism](../.agents/mechanisms/questions/questions.md)'s.

Implements [01-0060.0010](../tickets/01-0060.0010-what-the-path-shows-at-every-recall.md): the
path read from the records as they are — the count in work, what was raised lately and not taken
up, the candidates with their reasons, the three roots' balance — drawn by the store's script at
every wake and on request, and told by `/recall` in the person's words.

**Planning state:** authored 2026-10-24 against q-0037.0019's accepted `Where it stands`, its
decisions 1–6, the ticket, the recall skill, the questions mechanism's doc and the four scripts
the path reads. Validated once. Three choices taken here are under *Taken at `/plan`*; one
contradiction found in the governing docs is under *Raised for `/align`* and does not block the
slice.

## Governing boundaries

- **The path is a reading, never a record.** It is computed from what the records already hold
  and written nowhere; two sessions compute one path (q-0037.0019, `Where it stands`). The
  architecture's rule on scripts holds it: they enumerate and transform, and decide nothing
  ([Responsibilities](../architecture.md#responsibilities)).
- **The order is the person's; the path re-ranks nothing** (q-0037.0019 decision 1; `/recall`'s
  rule, *read the next item from the order the queue states*). The path shows candidates and
  their reasons; it does not say which is first.
- **The cap's number is the local file's** (L12); no script reads it. The path counts; the agent,
  who reads the entry file, compares.
- **Sessions' positions are not work** until the ring mark exists (q-0037.0019.0001, deferred); the
  count reads tickets In progress and says so.
- **The pathfinder is undeclared.** Its instruction into `/recall` and its moment in the store's
  doc are written by hand as straw dogs bound to q-0037.0019, as R5 has it for an undeclared
  mechanism; when it is declared, they become its installed blocks.
- **Every record stays as it is.** No new part of a question, no new field of a ticket, no new
  file: the path reads `owner`, `realizes`, `struck`, `depends on`, the tickets' `Status` and
  `Answers`, the product document's answers, and the straw dogs' bindings.

## Impact

**Must change.**

- `.agents/scripts/gw/questions.py`: a `--path` reading and its section in the wake; the tickets
  and product modules imported inside the function, since both import the store at the top.
- `.agents/scripts/gw/test/test_questions.py`: the path's tests.
- `.agents/skills/recall/SKILL.md`, *What the person hears*: one sentence telling the path, a straw
  dog bound to q-0037.0019.
- `.agents/mechanisms/questions/questions.md`, the moments table: a row, *drawing the path at the
  wake and on request*, instructed by the store's script, a straw dog bound to q-0037.0019.

**Must verify.**

- The wake's size: every recipient's hook delivers it at every session start, so the path is
  bounded — a handful of candidates, one line each root — the way *most struck* is bounded.
- The hook's output in a tree with no `docs/tickets/`, no product document and no rungs: the path
  shows what exists and nothing fails (criterion 6).
- The verification set green; the tests, since a script changes.

**Hidden edges.**

- **Circular import.** `tickets.py` and `product.py` import `questions`; the path imports them
  inside its function. A module of its own would be cleaner and is a new part of a mechanism to
  declare; not for this slice.
- **"Raised lately" is an approximation of "since the last boundary".** The store records a
  question's last touch, not its opening, and no boundary. The path names the open, unowned
  questions touched within the sessions' own horizon of seven days — the constant the session
  mechanism already keeps — and calls them *raised lately, not in work*; the exact reading is slice
  3's and q-0037.0019.0001's, marked `TODO q-0037.0019.0001` at the line.
- **The queue's order is not machine-readable** — see *Raised for `/align`*.
- **A recipient's path** reads the same records; one without a product document has every reason
  for the answer *unread*, which is the truth of that tree.

**Leave alone.** The queue's prose; `product.py --queue`, which renders coverage per item for the
person ordering and stays; the window and the rest of the wake; the dials and L12's number; the
store's grammar.

## Raised for `/align`

The ticket format says a position *changes when priority changes*; the queue's order is kept in
the README's prose and has moved without renumbering — `.0175` pulled forward on 2026-10-14,
01-0060.0010 put ahead of it on 2026-10-23, both by prose. So the positions do not encode the
order, and a path reading positions as the order would show `.0175` first. This slice does not
read an order at all: candidates are shown as a set with their reasons, in id order as every
listing is, and the order stays the queue's prose, read by `/recall` as today. Whether the
positions should follow the order again, or the format's sentence should go, is the pathfinder's
later slices' — the picture on a time axis — and is put to the person there, not here.

## Taken at `/plan`

1. **The path lives in the store's script, as a reading beside the wake.** Not a module of its own:
   that is a new part to declare, and the pathfinder has no mechanism yet; not in `product.py`:
   the path reads four mechanisms' records and the store is where the wake already is.
2. **Candidates are the live tickets whose Status is Ready, a handful at most**, in id order, plus
   the most struck open questions with no owner, a handful at most. Not: every live ticket — the
   path is read at every start; not: an order — the person's.
3. **A reason the records do not hold is written `unread`**, never inferred. The reasons: the
   answer served and whether it is present, from the trace link and the product document; the
   strikes; the straw dogs bound to the question or under it; what depends on it.

## Shapes

**The reading**, `questions.py --path`, and the same text as a `path:` section of the wake, after
*suspect* and before the window:

```
path:
  in work: 10 — tickets In progress; sessions not counted until the ring mark (q-0037.0019.0001)
    01-0010 a-shared-harness-improves… → q-0037.0006
    …
  raised lately, not in work: 3
    q-0037.0019.0002 … (struck 1, 2026-10-24)
  candidates, in id order, the order the queue's:
    01-0060.0010 what-the-path-shows-at-every-recall → q-0037.0019.0002
      serves A33 The queue read from ticket headers, in progress · struck 1 · 0 straw dogs · unlocks —
    01-0010.0175 arrival-describes-what-it-finds → q-0037.0006.0011
      serves unread · struck 0 · 2 straw dogs · unlocks —
  roots:
    q-0033 what the project is for — open 5, with a ticket 0 — thin
    q-0037 how it is built — open 160, with a ticket 76
    q-0038 the landscape — open 3, with a ticket 0 — thin
```

A root is *thin* when it has open questions and no ticket under it. *in progress* / *present* /
*absent* is the product script's coverage word for the answer; *unread* where the question has no
trace link or the tree no product document. The counts are integers the agent compares with L12.

**The telling**, in `/recall`'s *What the person hears*, as a straw dog bound to q-0037.0019:

> Then the path, in their words: how many pieces of work are in hand against the limit they set,
> what was raised lately and waits, which candidates stand next and why each, and whether a root
> has gone thin; asked where to go, the same.

**The moment**, in the questions mechanism's doc, under *Moments*, as a straw dog bound to
q-0037.0019:

> | drawing the path at the wake and on request | `.agents/scripts/gw/questions.py` | |

## Stages

Each stage ends green on the verification set; the tests run, a script changing.

1. **The reading, red first** in `test_questions.py`, a case class with a store, two tickets and a
   product document in the fixture:
   - a ticket In progress is counted and named with its question; a Ready one is not;
   - an open, unowned question touched within seven days is *raised lately*; an owned or old one
     is not;
   - a Ready ticket is a candidate with its four reasons read; a reason the records lack reads
     `unread`;
   - the most struck unowned open question is a candidate too;
   - each root's open and ticketed counts, and *thin* where ticketed is zero and open is not;
   - a tree with no tickets folder and no product document prints the roots and `unread`, and
     exits 0.

   Then `--path` and the section in the wake, bounded by two constants beside
   `WAKE_STRUCK_LINES`.
2. **The wake carries it**: a test that the wake's text holds the `path:` section after
   *suspect*; the hook unchanged, since it prints the wake.
3. **The telling and the moment**: the sentence in `/recall` and the row in the store's doc, each a
   straw dog bound to q-0037.0019; `mechanisms.py --check` and `inject_rules.py --check` green.
4. **Read live** (criteria 4 and 5): a `/recall` in this tree and a freeform *where should we go*,
   read by the person; an install into an empty folder read for criterion 6.

## Proof of the criteria

| Criterion | Proven by |
|---|---|
| the count in work against the cap, from tickets In progress, and what the cap held back | stage 1's first two cases; the live read |
| a handful of candidates with reasons, `unread` where unread | stage 1's third and fourth cases |
| the roots' counts and a thin root named | stage 1's fifth case |
| asked *where should we go*, the same picture | stage 4, read by the person |
| the person reads one recall and can say what is next and why | stage 4, read by the person |
| an empty install shows what exists and fails on nothing | stage 1's last case; stage 4's install |
| `/verify` passes | `/verify` after stage 4 |

## Out of scope

The weighing and any ordering of candidates by it — the parent's later slice. The time axis —
the parent's. Counting sessions in the ring — q-0037.0019.0001. The positions and the queue's
prose agreeing — *Raised for `/align`*, the parent's. A module of the pathfinder's own — when
it is declared.

  hold it; a proposal leans on the question it answers — what it is for. Look for its answer in
  the docs and the code first — found, point to it and open nothing for it; the turn is on the
  question that contains it, placed as above — a missing parent is still opened. Not found, or
  what the answer leaves unsettled, `open` it under the lowest question that contains what it
  asks, give it its parent's rung, raised where the question already shows a higher one, and call
  `at` on it.
- **A process**, carrying out what you know how to do: no call. One run for a question is a turn
  on that question.
- **Uncharted**, a question whose home you cannot settle: no call. Ask the user where it belongs,
  in every reply until answered.
- **Banter**, a message that asks nothing of the work — no question about the project, nothing
  to do or decide: no call. Answer it. The reply writes nothing and settles nothing; a doubt, or
  an answer that would do either, makes the turn another kind.

In the ring — a unit taken into work and held until the person drops it — a message that raises a
new question has it opened, placed and given its rung as a side question, and the session stays on
its unit: `open` without `at`.

The calls:

- `questions.py at q-0004 --session <tag>`
- `questions.py open '<question>' --under q-0004 --session <tag>`, which prints the id it gave
- `questions.py close q-0004 decided '[link](../path.md) — who, date' --session <tag>`

The store's other calls are made whenever the turn's own work settles, opens or moves a question.
Only the working agent calls, never a helper. For any other call, a closure, a branching or a
drop, read the questions skill.

**Q5** Every time a reply names a question — a table's cell included — its whole id is a link to its
entry; the first time, its question follows as the window writes it, save where a table's form
names it by its id alone. No word stands in for a question a reader has not been shown — *as
before*, *the same* — it is named. A question the store does not hold yet is written out, never
named after the ticket it will belong to.
</installed>

<installed by="session">
**S4** One party's work or claim colliding with another's — another session standing
where this one works — met and not resolved, is a row under `| 🪢 Tangle |`, even where a record's
disagreement is what shows it. The 🪢 table's header lists every running session's question, this
one's included, on one line, each by its id alone, linked to its entry, `—` for a session with no
position; each collision is a row under it, naming the sessions it involves. The table stands
whenever another session runs: its header is enough, with no collision under it, and it opens the
reply.

**S6** Run `/recall` first in every conversation, whatever the first message says. A conversation the host
resumes under a new id is the same conversation: its context holds the recall it ran.
</installed>

<installed by="debugging">
**D1** Open your first reply of every session with the entry file's `Entry contract:` line, verbatim.
</installed>

## Document load-bearing, code&comment the rest

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0002.0005">
A project's architecture, ADRs and glossary are the home for:
- Constitution — identity semantics, consistency model, source-of-truth rules
- Structure — service boundaries, data ownership, event/data flows, extension seams
- Load-bearing — see the definition below

A decision forms in the body of the question it answers and lands in one of these as it is made —
as a straw dog while an open question's answer can still change it. A decision about a
mechanism lands in that mechanism's doc, and what was refuted in its evidence.
</straw-dog>

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0002.0005">
Bad architectural documentation:
- Forecasts are stored in MongoDB collection forecast_hourly.

Better:
- Historical forecast issues must remain independently addressable by (location, valid_time, issue_time) because validation compares what was known at different issue times.
</straw-dog>

## What makes a thing "load-bearing"

- A decision or invariant whose violation would cause multiple parts of the system to become wrong, not merely require local refactoring.
- A thing is load-bearing when several of these are true: has high blast radius, crosses boundaries (i.e. services, persistence, APIs, ownership), other decisions depend on it, it protects an invariant,
is expensive to reverse, holds non-obvious rationale, long-standing.

- Counter-test: if it can be changed locally without understanding the rest of the architecture, it is not load-bearing.

## The loop

Two rings, joined at /align.

    session:   wake with /recall → /align → /conclude → (next session)
    delivery:  /ticket → /plan → /implement → /verify → /maintain → /ticket

/align opens the delivery ring and is where it returns whenever a decision is needed:
<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0002.0005">a load-bearing shape is aligned on its question until its `Where it stands` is accepted,</straw-dog> /plan when the governing docs contradict, /verify when a finding needs one, /maintain when maintenance surfaces one. /ticket⇄/plan and /implement⇄/verify iterate as pairs.

Human checkpoints: every decision at /align; a question's `Where it stands` accepted; and
whatever stands at or above its ladder's dial under [Autonomy](#autonomy).

Do not reopen an accepted decision without new evidence.

### Helpers

- /impact determines the scope and load-bearingness of the shape. Use it to evaluate work volume and its ticketing shape (<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0002.0005">an align on its question for load-bearing work, tickets for mechanical</straw-dog>), work units slicing or whether a shape deserves further investigation due to hidden complexity.
- /discover to investigate hidden complexity, by detecting what else the shape is.

## Self-improvement

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0012">
- A rule that was in place and did not fire was usually worded wrong. Register the failure in docs/rule-failures.md, or strike the entry it repeats, and propose the amendment that would have made it fire; /mechanism and /skill-up hold the means. Land the amendment in the same pass, showing its text first.
- A slip no rule covers is registered there too, described broadly enough to recognise its repeat;
  one proposes no rule.
- Keeping the register: an entry names the rules that were in play and proposes the amendment; a repeat strikes the entry it repeats rather than opening a second; an entry closes when its amendment lands, or is refused with its reason. Nothing here authorises deleting a rule.
</straw-dog>

## Autonomy

Autonomy is a dial on a ladder. A method whose decisions differ in how far their consequences
reach has a ladder, its rungs ordered by that reach and declared by the method's mechanism; a
method without one states which of its decisions are the agent's and which the person's. A
decision's rung is read from what it decides, never from the record that holds it; a case between
two rungs takes the higher.

- 🤖 Below the dial the agent settles and acts on its own.
- ✋ At the dial it settles, and shows the person before acting.
- 💬 Above it, it settles nothing: it brings the options and a recommendation, and the person
  decides.

A question carries its highest rung on each ladder it touches and stops for the person while that
rung is at or above the ladder's dial. Mending a violation is the work of the rung the mended thing
is on. Work closes with its commit once `/verify` passes on it; a push follows the project's way of
working with git, as its local file states.

The project sets each dial in its local block; an unset dial is at the lowest rung. The agent never
writes its dial<straw-dog question="q-0037.0006.0005">, and the host refuses an edit that changes it</straw-dog>.

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0002.0005">
Development's ladder, lowest first:

| rung | a decision on it — as the person is shown it |
|---|---|
| code | writing the code inside agreed work |
| a feature | what one piece of work should deliver |
| load-bearing | a load-bearing architectural decision, e.g. module boundaries |
| a product slice | what gets built next |
| the whole product | what the project is for |

An install proposes the dial at *a feature*.
</straw-dog>

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0012.0001">
Self-improvement's ladder, lowest first:

| rung | a decision on it — as the person is shown it |
|---|---|
| a wording | rewording an instruction, its meaning unchanged |
| a script | fixing a script that carries an instruction out |
| a rule | changing an instruction or a skill |
| the method | changing the way of working |

An install proposes the dial at *a rule*.
</straw-dog>

## Project-local

<installed by="mechanism-shape">
**R7** A project's own answers and overrides are authored in one file beside the entry file,
`local.rules.md`, in the rules-file format, and reach a file only as the local block — the
installed block whose owner is `local` — which the installer writes after every mechanism's block
there, so the project's answer is what a reader meets after core's rule. An override names the rule it
overrides. A local change to a rule is written in the local file, never into a skill or the entry
file, and re-installed. The local block is the project's,
not core's, and a redeploy preserves it.
</installed>

<installed by="local">
**L1** This repository develops the shared dev harness using its own loop; its own architecture and
progress live in docs/ like any other project's — the instance half doing its job, not a leak.
Terms: docs/glossary.md, this project's own; the method's are .agents/glossary.md's. What each
version of the entry contract changed: docs/research/entry-contract-findings.md.

**L2** development=a feature · self-improvement=a rule. Push each commit as it lands.

**L4** debug=on

**L5** Run a Python script with `uv run --offline --no-project python <script>`.

**L7** A correction that lands as a rule in this tree is not also written to the host's own memory
store outside the repository — Claude Code's auto-memory directory and its kin; that store holds
only what no record in this tree carries.

**L9** Write a reply's prose the way Lem wrote: plain, exact and dry, an argument the reader can follow,
irony where it is earned. It is never agent-speak, the voice of a tool narrating its own steps, and
it invents nothing: what it tells is what happened. Tables, decisions and text proposed for a
record keep the exactness their forms ask.

**L12** At most 8 open questions are in work at once — a running session in the ring on one or under it, or
its owner ticket In progress. The ninth is opened and placed, and waits until one leaves work.
</installed>

## Straw dogs

Wrap anything an open question's answer will change, as you write it — or, for text already
written, in the pass that opens the question: `<straw-dog question="q-N">`, bound to the question
whose answer will rewrite it, or in code a `TODO` naming `q-N` first. Treat *not yet*, *until*,
*once it exists*, *for now*, *untested* in your own text as the same signal: find the question, or
open one. Wrap at the authored home, never where the harness installs or derives it. Write the body
to stand on its own: it is what a recipient receives once the wrapper is stripped, so it names no
question or ticket — the binding does. Leave what no open question would change unwrapped.

Follow a straw dog like any other rule until it is due, as the listing and the wake report; then
act on reality, rewrite it to what is now true, and do not treat the contradiction as a violation.
</system-reminder>

План, простыми словами.

**Что появится.** При старте каждой сессии, и когда вы спросите «куда идём», агент покажет короткую картину пути, вычисленную из записей дерева. Картина из четырёх частей:

1. **В работе.** Сколько единиц работы сейчас в руках: тикеты со статусом In progress, каждый со своим вопросом. Сессии в этот счёт не входят, потому что хранилище пока не умеет отличать сессию, держащую работу, от сессии, которая просто разговаривает; строка так и скажет. Число предела (восемь) скрипт не знает и не читает: он считает, а агент, который читает входной файл, сравнивает и говорит вам «десять против восьми».
2. **Поднято недавно и не взято.** Открытые вопросы без тикета, которых кто-то касался за последние семь дней. Это приближение к «идеи, сказанные с последней границы»: точной границы хранилище не пишет, а дату касания пишет; семь дней это горизонт, который механизм сессий уже использует для своих нужд. В коде это место помечено как временное, с привязкой к отложенному вопросу о метке кольца.
3. **Кандидаты.** Горстка, не больше пяти: тикеты со статусом Ready и, отдельно, самые задетые открытые вопросы без тикета. У каждого четыре причины, все прочитанные из записей, ничего не выдумывается: какой ответ продуктового документа он обслуживает и построен ли этот ответ, по следу вопроса к ответу и по покрытию; сколько раз к нему возвращались, по счётчику ударов; сколько соломенных собак на нём висит, то есть сколько временного текста ждёт его ответа; кто от него зависит. Где записи причины не держат, пишется слово `unread`, непрочитано. Кандидаты показываются списком по номеру, без порядка: порядок остаётся вашим и живёт в прозе очереди, как сейчас.
4. **Корни.** Для каждого из трёх корневых вопросов, для чего проект, как построен, в каком ландшафте: сколько открытых вопросов под ним и сколько из них с тикетом. Корень с открытыми вопросами и без единого тикета помечается словом *thin*, тощий.

**Где это живёт.** Внутри скрипта хранилища вопросов, как ещё одно его чтение: вызов `--path` печатает картину, и та же картина становится секцией `path:` в тексте пробуждения, который хук уже кладёт каждой сессии в контекст при старте. Ничего не записывается, новых файлов, полей и частей нет; две сессии вычислят одну и ту же картину. Выбор сделан так, а не отдельным скриптом, потому что отдельный скрипт надо объявлять частью какого-то механизма, а пафайндер ещё не объявлен (💡 [*Occam*](AGENTS.md:30)).

**Как это дойдёт до вас.** В скилл `/recall`, в раздел о том, что слышит человек, добавится одно предложение: рассказать путь вашими словами, сколько в руках против предела, что поднято и ждёт, кто кандидаты и почему каждый, не истончился ли корень; на вопрос «куда идём» то же самое. В документ механизма вопросов, в таблицу моментов, добавится строка: «рисование пути при пробуждении и по просьбе». Обе добавки обёрнуты соломенными собаками к вопросу пафайндера, потому что когда пафайндер станет механизмом, они переедут к нему (💡 [*R5*](.claude/skills/align/SKILL.md:144)).

**В каком порядке делается.**

1. Сначала тесты, красные: тикет In progress считается, Ready не считается; свежий вопрос без владельца попадает в «поднято недавно», старый или с владельцем нет; у кандидата читаются четыре причины, недостающая пишется `unread`; самый задетый вопрос без владельца тоже кандидат; у корней верные числа и *thin* где надо; дерево без папки тикетов и без продуктового документа печатает корни и `unread` и не падает. Потом код, пока тесты не позеленеют.
2. Пробуждение несёт секцию `path:`; тест, что она есть и стоит после «suspect». Хук не меняется.
3. Предложение в `/recall` и строка в документе механизма; проверки установщика и механизмов зелёные.
4. Живое чтение: один `/recall` в этом дереве и один вопрос «куда идём» в разговоре, прочитанные судьёй, который этого не строил; установка в пустую папку, чтобы увидеть, что картина показывает то, что есть, и ничего не ломает.

**Чего план не делает.** Не взвешивает кандидатов и не ставит их в порядок, это следующие срезы, после того как предел и шлюз понаблюдаем. Не рисует ось времени. Не считает сессии в кольце. Не трогает прозу очереди.

**Что нашлось по дороге.** Формат тикета говорит, что номер тикета меняется, когда меняется приоритет, а на деле порядок очереди живёт в прозе README и двигался без перенумерации; номера порядок больше не кодируют. Срез порядок не читает вовсе, поэтому не ломается об это; но согласовать номера с порядком или убрать фразу из формата надо будет в срезе про ось времени.

"""A preview of 01-0060.0010's path, computed from the tree as it stands; not the implementation."""
import re
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(sys.argv[1])
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / ".agents/scripts/gw"))
import questions, tickets, product  # noqa: E402
from docs_corpus import corpus, question_bindings  # noqa: E402

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
store = questions.read_store(root)
index = store.index
live = {k: v for k, v in index.items() if not v.archived}
QID = re.compile(r"q-\d{4}(?:\.\d{4})*")

def ancestry(q):
    at = live.get(q)
    while at is not None:
        yield at
        at = live.get(at.parent or "")

def owned(q):
    return any("owner" in a.parts and "/done/" not in a.parts["owner"].value for a in ancestry(q))

read = [tickets._read(root, n) for n in tickets.live_tickets(corpus(root))]
read = [t for t in read if not isinstance(t, tickets.Skipped)]
def status(t): return (t.fields.get("Status") or "").split(" (")[0].strip()
def answers(t):
    m = QID.search(t.fields.get("Answers") or "")
    return m.group(0) if m else None
def label(t):
    b = Path(t.record).stem
    m = re.match(r"(\d\d-[\d.]+)-(.*)", b)
    return f"{m.group(1)} {m.group(2)}" if m else b

cover = {}
for line in product.coverage(root):
    m = re.match(r"(A\d+) .*? — (present|in progress|absent)", line)
    if m: cover[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
bindings = question_bindings(root)

def reasons(q, ticket=None):
    link = questions.realizes(index, q) if q else None
    if link and link.answers:
        serves = ", ".join(f"{r} {n}, {cover.get(r, 'unread')}" for r, n in link.answers)
    elif link and link.derived:
        serves = "derived"
    else:
        serves = "unread"
    struck = live[q].strike.count if q in live and live[q].strike else 0
    dogs = sum(1 for _, _, i in bindings if q and (i == q or i.startswith(q + ".")))
    unlocks = [k for k, v in live.items() if v.open and q and any(d == q or d.startswith(q + ".") for d in v.dependencies)]
    if ticket is not None:
        stem = Path(ticket.record).stem
        unlocks += [label(t) for t in read if stem in (t.fields.get("Depends on") or "")]
    return f"serves {serves} · struck {struck} · {dogs} straw dogs · unlocks {', '.join(unlocks) or '—'}"

in_work = [t for t in read if status(t) == "In progress"]
ready = [t for t in read if status(t) == "Ready"]
lately = sorted(
    (v for k, v in live.items() if v.open and not owned(k) and v.strike and now - v.strike.last <= timedelta(days=7)),
    key=lambda v: v.strike.last, reverse=True,
)
struck_unowned = sorted(
    (v for k, v in live.items() if v.open and not owned(k) and v.strike and v.strike.count),
    key=lambda v: -v.strike.count,
)[:3]

out = ["path:", f"  in work: {len(in_work)} — tickets In progress; sessions not counted until the ring mark (q-0037.0019.0001)"]
out += [f"    {label(t)} → {answers(t) or 'unread'}" for t in in_work]
out.append(f"  raised lately, not in work: {len(lately)}")
out += [f"    {v.identity} {v.question[:80]}… (struck {v.strike.count}, {v.strike.last:%Y-%m-%d})" for v in lately[:5]]
if len(lately) > 5:
    out.append(f"    … and {len(lately) - 5} more")
out.append("  candidates, in id order, the order the queue's:")
for t in ready[:5]:
    out.append(f"    {label(t)} → {answers(t) or 'unread'}")
    out.append(f"      {reasons(answers(t), t)}")
for v in struck_unowned:
    out.append(f"    {v.identity} {v.question[:70]}… — no ticket")
    out.append(f"      {reasons(v.identity)}")
out.append("  roots:")
for rid, words in (("q-0033", "what the project is for"), ("q-0037", "how it is built"), ("q-0038", "the landscape")):
    under = [k for k, v in live.items() if k.startswith(rid + ".") and v.open]
    ticketed = [k for k in under if owned(k)]
    thin = " — thin" if under and not ticketed else ""
    out.append(f"    {rid} {words} — open {len(under)}, with a ticket {len(ticketed)}{thin}")
print("\n".join(out))

content.content:
**Authored:** 2026-10-24

Implements [01-0060.0010](../tickets/01-0060.0010-what-the-path-shows-at-every-recall.md): the
path read from the records as they are — the count in work, what was raised lately and not taken
up, the candidates with their reasons, the three roots' balance — drawn by the store's script at
every wake and on request, and told by `/recall` in the person's words.

**Planning state:** authored 2026-10-24 against q-0037.0019's accepted `Where it stands`, its
decisions 1–6, the ticket, the recall skill, the questions mechanism's doc and the four scripts
the path reads. Validated once. Three choices taken here are under *Taken at `/plan`*; one
contradiction found in the governing docs is under *Raised for `/align`* and does not block the
slice.
- **Circular import.** `tickets.py` and `product.py` import `questions`; the path imports them
  inside its function. A module of its own would be cleaner and is a new part of a mechanism to
  declare; not for this slice.
- **"Raised lately" is an approximation of "since the last boundary".** The store records a
  question's last touch, not its opening, and no boundary. The path names the open, unowned
  questions touched within the sessions' own horizon of seven days — the constant the session
  mechanism already keeps — and calls them *raised lately, not in work*; the exact reading is slice
  3's and q-0037.0019.0001's, marked `TODO q-0037.0019.0001` at the line.
- **The queue's order is not machine-readable** — see *Raised for `/align`*.
- **A recipient's path** reads the same records; one without a product document has every reason
  for the answer *unread*, which is the truth of that tree.

**The reading**, `questions.py --path`, and the same text as a `path:` section of the wake, after
*suspect* and before the window:

```
path:
  in work: 10 — tickets In progress; sessions not counted until the ring mark (q-0037.0019.0001)
    01-0010 a-shared-harness-improves… → q-0037.0006
    …
  raised lately, not in work: 3
    q-0037.0019.0002 … (struck 1, 2026-10-24)
  candidates, in id order, the order the queue's:
    01-0060.0010 what-the-path-shows-at-every-recall → q-0037.0019.0002
      serves A33 The queue read from ticket headers, in progress · struck 1 · 0 straw dogs · unlocks —
    01-0010.0175 arrival-describes-what-it-finds → q-0037.0006.0011
      serves unread · struck 0 · 2 straw dogs · unlocks —
  roots:
    q-0033 what the project is for — open 5, with a ticket 0 — thin
    q-0037 how it is built — open 160, with a ticket 76
    q-0038 the landscape — open 3, with a ticket 0 — thin
```

A root is *thin* when it has open questions and no ticket under it. *in progress* / *present* /
*absent* is the product script's coverage word for the answer; *unread* where the question has no
trace link or the tree no product document. The counts are integers the agent compares with L12.

**The telling**, in `/recall`'s *What the person hears*, as a straw dog bound to q-0037.0019:

> Then the path, in their words: how many pieces of work are in hand against the limit they set,
> what was raised lately and waits, which candidates stand next and why each, and whether a root
> has gone thin; asked where to go, the same.

**The moment**, in the questions mechanism's doc, under *Moments*, as a straw dog bound to

Each stage ends green on the verification set; the tests run, a script changing.

1. **The reading, red first** in `test_questions.py`, a case class with a store, two tickets and a
   product document in the fixture:
   - a ticket In progress is counted and named with its question; a Ready one is not;
   - an open, unowned question touched within seven days is *raised lately*; an owned or old one
     is not;
   - a Ready ticket is a candidate with its four reasons read; a reason the records lack reads
     `unread`;
   - the most struck unowned open question is a candidate too;
   - each root's open and ticketed counts, and *thin* where ticketed is zero and open is not;
   - a tree with no tickets folder and no product document prints the roots and `unread`, and
     exits 0.

   Then `--path` and the section in the wake, bounded by two constants beside
   `WAKE_STRUCK_LINES`.
2. **The wake carries it**: a test that the wake's text holds the `path:` section after
   *suspect*; the hook unchanged, since it prints the wake.
3. **The telling and the moment**: the sentence in `/recall` and the row in the store's doc, each a
   straw dog bound to q-0037.0019; `mechanisms.py --check` and `inject_rules.py --check` green.
4. **Read live** (criteria 4 and 5): a `/recall` in this tree and a freeform *where should we go*,
   read by the person; an install into an empty folder read for criterion 6.

## Proof of the criteria

| Criterion | Proven by |
|---|---|
| the count in work against the cap, from tickets In progress, and what the cap held back | stage 1's first two cases; the live read |
| a handful of candidates with reasons, `unread` where unread | stage 1's third and fourth cases |
| the roots' counts and a thin root named | stage 1's fifth case |
| asked *where should we go*, the same picture | stage 4, read by the person |
| the person reads one recall and can say what is next and why | stage 4, read by the person |
| an empty install shows what exists and fails on nothing | stage 1's last case; stage 4's install |
| `/verify` passes | `/verify` after stage 4 |

**Формат тикета.** Фраза о приоритете стоит в одном разделе, в двух местах, и больше её никто не читает. Но она там не одна: «вставлять, деля разницу пополам» и «выделять позицию там, где тикет будет делаться» тоже предполагают, что номер означает порядок. Если порядок живёт в очереди, как говорит архитектура, номер становится просто именем, и весь раздел сжимается (💡 [*Occam*](AGENTS.md:30)):

🧩 **Proposed rule — [.agents/skills/ticket/TICKET-FORMAT.md](.agents/skills/ticket/TICKET-FORMAT.md) · Numbering**

> ```
> docs/tickets/done/01-0090.0030-the-outcome-it-names.md
>               │  │    └── slug — what the ticket is.
>               │  └─────── position — its identity, never changed; the order of the work is the queue's.
>               └────────── release — the contract the ticket serves.
> ```
>
> - Names are `01-NNNN-slug.md`. A new ticket takes the next free position after its siblings', live and done, stepping by 10; positions stay four digits. Never renumber.
> - A child appends a four-digit position: `01-0090.0030`. Depth is unbounded and means "is a child of", nothing else — work merely filed after `0010` takes `0020`.
> - A release closes when its contract's criteria are met, not on a date. A later release's ticket may land first.

Уходят: «меняется с приоритетом», «деля разницу пополам», «на свободное место с нужной стороны», «там, где будет делаться», и «завершённые сохраняют номер», которое съедает «никогда не перенумеровывать». Старые номера вроде `0172` остаются как есть. Это правило, показываю и не кладу.

**Что сейчас происходит с голосом.** Во входном файле три голоса, и ни один не знает своей границы:

- **Голос инструкций и записей.** «Пиши для способной модели: правило и указатель». Верно для скиллов и документов. Но стоит в общих правилах, без оговорки, и агент читает его как правило и для ответов. Отсюда плотные ответы со слагами, на которые вы жалуетесь не первый раз.
- **Голос речи.** L9, голос Лема, локальное правило проекта. Рядом правило о том, что ответ говорит и чего не говорит. И разделы «что слышит человек» в трёх скиллах, где написано то «в их словах», то «в их терминах». Каждая такая фраза тянет в свою сторону и сбивает L9.
- **Показанная машинерия.** Механизм отладки, объявлен два дня назад. Это противоположный полюс: что показывать сверх речи.

Вопрос о том, кто владеет формой ответа, уже назвал двух хозяев: отладку или взаимодействие. Отладку построили, взаимодействие так и не открыли. Голос и есть эта половина.

**Как я вижу механизм голоса.** Он владеет тем, *как* сказано всё, что слышит человек: в любом ответе, в отчёте, внутри скилла и вне его. Голос проекта становится его настройкой: здесь Лем, в другом проекте другой. Он не владеет тем, *что* сказано в данный момент: это остаётся разделам «что слышит человек» в скиллах, потому что только скилл знает свой момент. Так что не управляющий этими разделами, а управляющий их речью. Сами разделы теряют «в их словах» и «в их терминах»: голос прикладывается ко всей речи сразу.

Что из этого следует сразу, без механизма: «пиши для способной модели» получает границу, инструкции и записи; это его дом в скилле о написании инструкций, а не общие правила.

**Чего бы я не делал.** Не делал бы голос списком запретов: «не слаги, не номера, не имена записей». Это опыт сессии 15 октября: правило не может сделать голос, список форм сбоя описывает сбой, а не голос. Голос задаётся образцом, Лемом, и одним требованием: сказанное понятно человеку без файлов. Остальное приходит из образца (💡 [*Occam*](AGENTS.md:30)).

**Что это значит для пути.** Правку в `/recall`, которую я предлагал, теперь писать не надо: «в их словах и словах продукта» как раз из тех фраз, что сбивают голос. Срез пути остаётся как есть, а его рассказ ждёт голоса.

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0002.0005">
## Good architecture

Goal of architecture is to reduce work on creation and maintenance of the system.

Identify the load-bearing assumption behind the proposed shape; ask yourself - what is the cheapest real example that could prove this design assumption wrong? 

Check it when practical, preferably against external reality rather than our own documents and tests.

If falsified, realign.
If unverified and load-bearing, preserve the uncertainty explicitly.

## Domain awareness

During codebase exploration, also look for existing documentation:

### File structure

Most repos have a single context:

```
/
├── docs/
│   ├── adr/
│   │   ├── 0001-event-sourced-orders.md
│   │   └── 0002-postgres-for-write-model.md
│   ├── architecture.md
│   └── glossary.md
└── src/
```

Create files lazily — only when you have something to write. If no `docs/glossary.md` exists, create one when the first term is resolved. If no `docs/adr/` exists, create it when the first ADR is needed.
</straw-dog>

## During the session

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0001.0001">
### Challenge against the glossary

When the user uses a term that conflicts with the existing language in `docs/glossary.md`, call it out immediately. "Your glossary defines 'cancellation' as X, but you seem to mean Y — which is it?"

This cuts both ways: before *you* propose a name, check the glossary yourself — including its _Avoid_ lists, which are reservations, not suggestions. If every synonym for a concept is avoided, that is a designed constraint telling you which word the project has chosen; work within it rather than proposing around it.
</straw-dog>

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0002.0005">
### Check whether it was already decided

Before treating a question as open, search the ADRs and architecture docs for it. A surprising amount of "open" questions are accepted decisions the code drifted from — the answer then is "implement the ADR", not a fresh trade-off analysis. Cite the deciding document when you find one.
</straw-dog>

### Challenge against the Edge records

<installed by="edge">
**E3** When the plan touches an edge — where the system meets those who consume it or extend it — check
that edge's record under `docs/edge/`. A contradiction with its Contract or Invariants is either a
plan bug or a deliberate contract change, and a contract change is named **breaking or
compatible** out loud before proceeding. As decisions land, write them into the record in the
shape of `.agents/skills/edge/EDGE-FORMAT.md`: a contract change in `Contract` and `Invariants`,
marked `⚠ pending — <ticket>` until its ticket lands and the record set `Normative (tentative)`
while any is pending, a promise without a validator marked **⚠ unguarded**; newly surfaced
edge-scoped concerns as pointers in `Concerns`; staging shifts in `Roadmap`.
</installed>

### Lead with the decisive fact

When recommending between alternatives, find the fact that settles it — a reader count, an import direction, an existing invariant, what a test actually asserts — and lead with it. A pros/cons menu with no decisive fact means you haven't explored enough yet; go look before asking.

### Name the shared assumption

When posing an A-or-B fork, state the assumption both branches share. The user's best answer may dissolve the fork rather than pick a branch — treat "the premise is wrong" as a first-class outcome, not a detour. If a fork keeps resisting resolution, that is usually the sign.

### Sharpen fuzzy language

When the user uses vague or overloaded terms, propose a precise canonical term. "You're saying 'account' — do you mean the Customer or the User? Those are different things."

### Discuss concrete scenarios

When domain relationships are being discussed, stress-test them with specific scenarios. Invent scenarios that probe edge cases and force the user to be precise about the boundaries between concepts.

### Cross-reference with code

When the user states how something works, check whether the code agrees. If you find a contradiction, surface it: "Your code cancels entire Orders, but you just said partial cancellation is possible — which is right?"

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0001.0001">
### Update glossary.md inline

When a term is resolved, update `docs/glossary.md` right there. Don't batch these up — capture them as they happen. Use the format in [GLOSSARY-FORMAT.md](./GLOSSARY-FORMAT.md).

`docs/glossary.md` should be totally devoid of implementation details. Do not treat it as a spec, a scratch pad, or a repository for implementation decisions. It is a glossary and nothing else.
</straw-dog>

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0002.0005">
### Update architecture.md inline

When high-level architecture of this project changes, update `architecture.md`. Use format in [ARCH-FORMAT.md](./ARCH-FORMAT.md).

`architecture.md` document captures the **high-level architecture**. Lower-level concerns are intentionally **deferred** and listed at the end.
> Scope note: everything here is at the architecture/contract level. Where a concrete shape would prematurely lock a deferred decision, we define only the *seam*.
> You should guide the user toward deep modules with simple boundaries.
</straw-dog>


### Land resolutions as they are made

Land each resolution the moment it is made, as the blocks below say.

<installed by="mechanism-shape">
**R5** Land a mechanism's rule in AGENTS.md only as an installed block from its rules file. While the
mechanism is undeclared, write the rule by hand and wrap it as a straw dog bound to the question
of what the mechanism owns, as you write it.
</installed>

<installed by="ticket">
**P7** Rewrite the ticket in place to what the align's landed decisions make true.

**P10** Open an align by saying what its work is: what it builds and the problem it answers, in plain
words, each of its terms explained, before the necessity gate or any question.

**P11** Sweep the question's body, and the ticket where there is one, for internal consistency at the end:
an early line may still assert what a later resolution changed.
</installed>

<installed by="questions">
**Q6** Land a decision as it is made, with its provenance: final in its durable home where no open
question's answer can change its form or home, otherwise as a straw dog bound to the nearest open
ancestor whose answer can. One with nowhere to land yet — its home is work not done — is a line in
the `## Decisions` list of the lowest question holding everyone who needs it, and takes
`→ <link>` when it lands. Close the question it answers against where it landed, and when a line
lands, repoint every entry closed against its list there. A decision not to do what nothing
instructs lands in its question alone.
</installed>

<installed by="product">
**U2** When a question under *What is this project for?* is decided with something to build, do three
things in one step:

1. With `/product`, write the answer into the document: a row that waits on this question has
   its *waits on* cell emptied; otherwise a new row takes the next number.
2. Close the question against that row.
3. Open the question of how to build it in the *How is this project built?* branch, under the
   question it belongs to, and give it its trace link with `questions.py realize`, naming the

A decision that changes, replaces or retires an answer is written by `/product` the same way.
</installed>

<straw-dog question="q-0037.0010.0002.0005">
### Offer ADRs sparingly

Only offer to create an ADR when all three are true:

1. **Hard to reverse** — the cost of changing your mind later is meaningful
2. **Surprising without context** — a future reader will wonder "why did they do it this way?"
3. **The result of a real trade-off** — there were genuine alternatives and you picked one for specific reasons

If any of the three is missing, skip the ADR. Use the format in [ADR-FORMAT.md](./ADR-FORMAT.md).
</straw-dog>

## debugging mechanism head
# debugging — shows a tree's own working to the person exactly while the tree's settings say so

- **instruction** `.agents/skills/debugging/SKILL.md` — what a tree shows of its own working, and where that text comes from
- **state** installed
- **record of** what must always hold

## How it works

What a reply shows of the machinery behind it — a session's announce line, the marks a paragraph
carries, the tables that open a reply — is this mechanism's text. It reaches a tree as installed
blocks, each rule conditioned `when debug=on`, and the project sets `debug` in its local file:
a tree at `off` carries none of it, and a session reads no switch to know which. One text never
holds both readings behind a switch a session reads, because a reader who must evaluate the
switch pays for both readings and can take the wrong one *(the user, 2026-10-18)*.

The setting is this mechanism's to declare — its name, its values, its default, who may set it —
and any installed mechanism's rule may use it: the session mechanism's 🪢 table is conditioned on
it and does not own it. Switching is the agent's, through `/harness`, at the rung the declaration
names.

It is **installed**. A tree without it shows nothing of its working and reads no `debug`; the

|---|

| 📍 **q-0037.0009.0021.0002** · Is the voice a reply speaks in its own mechanism, owning how everything the person hears is said, apart from the voice instructions and records are written in? |
|---|
| ⚙️ /align |

**Что за работа.** Голос это то, *как* звучит всё, что слышит человек: ответ в разговоре, отчёт после прохода, рассказ при старте сессии. Не *что* сказано, а каким языком: ритм, точность, отношение к читателю. У этого проекта голос выбран: Лем, правило L9. Работа в том, чтобы у голоса был один дом, и чтобы другие тексты перестали его сбивать.

**Ворота необходимости.**

Заказчик вы. Наблюдаемая беда, по записям:

- **14 октября**, сбой 48. За сорок ходов ответы ушли от голоса Лема: таблицы вместо рассуждения, слова, введённые и не объяснённые, агент, пересказывающий свои шаги. Поправку списком таких форм вы откатили: *меня интересует голос Лема, а не то, что ты написал*.
- **Эта сессия.** Вы несколько раз не поняли ответы: варианты, куда ставятся правила, наконец сегодняшний вывод пути, *нечитаемо*.
- **Сегодня** вы назвали источник: фразы «в их словах», «пиши для способной модели» сбивают настройку голоса.

Почему нынешнее не справляется. У голоса три дома, и они спорят:

| где | что говорит | кому верно |
|---|---|---|
| общие правила входного файла | пиши для способной модели: правило и указатель | инструкциям и записям |
| пять фраз в скиллах и входном файле | «в их словах», «в их терминах», «на их языке» | никому точно |
| L9, локальное правило | голос Лема | речи этого проекта |

И решающий факт: ядро отдаёт получателям первые два дома, а третий нет. L9 локальное, в другой проект оно не едет. Значит, каждый получатель получает спор без голоса. Ворота, по-моему, проходятся.

**Первый вопрос: нужен ли механизм, или хватит уборки.** Общая предпосылка обоих вариантов: голос выбирает проект, ядро только даёт ему место.

- **А. Только уборка.** «Способную модель» ограничить инструкциями и записями, пять фраз убрать, L9 оставить локальным правилом. Дёшево, и голос в этом дереве перестанут сбивать. Но получатель по-прежнему не получает никакого голоса и никакого места для своего.
- **Б. Маленький механизм голоса.** Он объявляет одну настройку, голос речи, как механизм отладки объявляет `debug`. Значение настройки принадлежит проекту: здесь это нынешний текст L9, у получателя то, что он выберет, а до выбора нейтральное «просто и ясно для человека». И он ставит одно правило в входной файл: всё, что слышит человек, сказано этим голосом. Уборка из А входит в него же.

Рекомендую **Б**. Решает не изящество, а факт выше: без места для голоса в ядре каждый получатель остаётся со спором и без голоса, а у нас голос висит на локальном правиле, которое соседние фразы ядра перебивают. И одно, чего я делать не стал бы ни в А, ни в Б: описывать голос списком запретов. Это сбой 48, откат был ваш (💡 [*Occam*](AGENTS.md:30)).

А, Б, или предпосылка неверна?

session. As it read until today: *"What you write to serve only until a named ticket replaces it
is a straw dog. Wrap it as you write it…"*

unwrapped straw dogs, written in at least three different sessions: `/ticket`'s *"it does not yet
recommend…"* (01-0010.0080), `.agents/README.md`'s *"which links are actually required is
untested"* (01-0010.0120) and its after-clone procedure ending *"once it exists"* (01-0010.0130).

*once it exists*, *until the pacer exists* — and none was wrapped.

**Why it did not fire** *(the user, 2026-09-14)*: **the rule was phrased descriptively, with the
imperative buried as a secondary clause.** It opened with a definition of what a straw dog *is* and
told the writer what to do once they already knew they were writing one. It never named how they
would know, so the tells the writers themselves produced went unconnected to it.

outside cannot fire on a writer who experiences the act from the inside, whatever tier it sits at.

Верно, и это меняет решение 3. Прочитал все двадцать пять скиллов ядра; они делятся на четыре рода:

| как скилл встречается с человеком | скиллы | где написано, что он говорит |
|---|---|---|
| разговор и есть работа | align, advise, discover, review-architecture, celebrate | по всему телу: интервью, совет, материал, отданный в том же ходе |
| говорит в свой момент, раздел есть | recall, harness, maintain | раздел «что слышит человек» |
| говорит в свой момент, раздела нет | ticket (показать разбиение), conclude, questions (сообщить решённое, спросить, куда положить), tdd (какое поведение важно) | разбросано по телу |
| работает молча, ход сообщает итог | plan, implement, verify, impact, improve-comments, product, setup-devops, commit, skill-up, edge, mechanism, debugging, dream | ничего своего; общая форма ответа |

Отсюда две разные вещи под словом «что сказано»:

- **Что сказано в данный момент.** «Где стоит работа» это слова `/recall`. «Что было не в согласии» это слова `/maintain`. Знает свой момент только скилл. Голос этим владеть не может.
- **Что говорит и чего не говорит любой ответ,** какой бы скилл ни работал. Ответ называет вопрос, шаг, решённое, следующее и где остановка. Он никогда не называет скрипт, вызов или устройство записи. Это общее, это правило «ответ говорит методом», и его голос взять может.

Поэтому предлагаю поправить решение 3. Голос владеет тем, как сказана вся речь в сессии, и общим правилом о том, что ответ говорит и чего не говорит. То, что сказано в свой момент, остаётся у говорящего скилла. Записи по-прежнему не его.

Одно следствие, на потом. Четыре скилла говорят в свой момент, но раздела для этого у них нет. Если голос станет механизмом, у которого моменты речи объявлены, такие места окажутся без дома. Вопрос в том, должен ли каждый говорящий скилл держать раздел «что слышит человек». Это следующий шаг, если поправка ляжет.

Верно ли я развёл «что»?

# Mechanism: product
"""The product document's answers, and each answer's coverage read from the questions that realize it."""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import io
import json
import unittest

from repository import RepositoryCase

import product

DOCUMENT = "docs/product.md"
STORE = "docs/questions"


def document(*rows: str) -> str:
    """A product document whose answers table holds the rows given, under one group heading."""
    return (
        "# What the project is for\n\n## Pains\n\n1. **It hurts.**\n\n## Causes\n\n- **C1** A cause.\n\n"
        "## Answers\n\n| answer | causes | 1 | waits on |\n|---|---|---|---|\n"
        "| **The first group** | | | |\n" + "".join(f"{row}\n" for row in rows) + "\n## After\n\nProse.\n"
    )


def answer(identity: str, name: str, waits: str = "") -> str:
    return f"| **{identity} {name}** — what it does | C1 | ● | {waits} |"


def waiting_on(identity: str) -> str:
    return f'<straw-dog question="{identity}">✗</straw-dog>'


def question(
    identity: str,
    state: str = "open",
    parent: str | None = None,
    realizes: str | None = None,
    words: str | None = None,
    owner: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    kind = "what it intends to become" if state.startswith("open") else "what happened"
    parts = [f"- **record of** {kind}"]
    parts += [f"- **part of** {parent}"] if parent else []
    parts += [f"- **state** {state}"]
    parts += [f"- **owner** [{owner.split('/')[-1][:7]}](../{owner})"] if owner else []
    parts += ["- **answer** a reason"] if not state.startswith("open") else []
    parts += [f"- **realizes** {realizes}"] if realizes else []
    return "\n".join([f"# {identity} {words or f'Question {identity}?'}", "", *parts]) + "\n"


class Product(RepositoryCase):
    def run_script(self, *argv: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
        said = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(said):
            status = product.main(list(argv), root=self.root)
        return status, said.getvalue()

    def checked(self) -> tuple[int, dict]:
        status, said = self.run_script("--check")
        return status, json.loads(said)

    def place(self, identity: str, text: str, folder: str = STORE) -> None:
        self.write(f"{folder}/{identity}-question-{identity.replace('.', '-')}.md", text)


class ATreeWithNoProductDocument(Product):
    def test_the_check_finds_nothing_and_passes(self) -> None:
        status, report = self.checked()

        self.assertEqual(0, status)
        self.assertEqual({"document": None, "answers": 0, "diagnostics": [], "findings": []}, report)

    def test_the_check_reports_no_orphan_without_a_document(self) -> None:
        self.place("q-0002", question("q-0002", words="How is this project built?"))
        self.place("q-0002.0001", question("q-0002.0001", parent="q-0002"))

        self.assertEqual([], self.checked()[1]["findings"])
class TheQueue(Product):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        super().setUp()
        self.write(DOCUMENT, QUEUED)
        self.place("q-0001", question("q-0001", realizes='A1 "Built by an item"', owner="tickets/01-0001-first.md"))
        self.place("q-0001.0001", question("q-0001.0001", parent="q-0001", owner="tickets/01-0001.0010-second.md"))
        self.place(
            "q-0001.0002",
            question("q-0001.0002", parent="q-0001", realizes='A5 "For nothing"', owner="tickets/01-0001-first.md"),
        )
        self.place("q-0001.0002.0001", question("q-0001.0002.0001", parent="q-0001.0002", owner="tickets/01-0001-first.md"))
        self.place("q-0002", question("q-0002", realizes="derived", owner="tickets/01-0002-aside.md"))

    """A test whose subject is a fresh tree at `self.root`: a real repository when the case
    proves a process, a plain folder with every process refused when it does not."""

    def another_repository(self) -> Path:
        """A second fresh tree beside `self.root`, for a case whose subject acts across two
        trees — an install of core from one into the other. Cleaned up with the case."""
        return self._fresh_tree()

    def _proves_a_process(self) -> bool:
        test = getattr(self, self._testMethodName)
        return getattr(test, "proves_a_process", False) or type(self).proves_a_process

    def _fresh_tree(self) -> Path:
        workspace = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(workspace.cleanup)
        tree = Path(workspace.name).resolve()

    def _refuse_processes(self) -> None:
        """Any process start fails the case, naming what it tried: `run`, `check_output` and the

        def refused(arguments, *_, **__):

    open question, a deferred one with it, or a decided one realizes."""

def path_ticket(title: str, status: str, answers: str, depends: str = "") -> str:
    """A live ticket's header, enough for the path to read: its title, status and question."""
    lines = [f"# {title}", "", "- **record of** what it intends to become", f"- **Status:** {status}",
             "- **Type:** AFK", "- **Minted:** 2026-09-29"]
    lines += [f"- **Depends on:** {depends}"] if depends else []
    lines += [f"- **Answers:** [{answers}](../questions/{answers}-q.md)", "- **Outcome:** It works.", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


class ThePath(RepositoryCase):
    """The path read from the records as they are (01-0060.0010): what is in work, what was touched
    lately with no ticket, the candidates with their reasons, and the roots' balance."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        super().setUp()
        remember_windows_in_the_case(self)

    def question(self, identity: str, words: str, parent: str | None = None, owner: str | None = None,
                 struck: tuple[int, int] | None = None, realizes: str | None = None) -> None:
        parts = {"part of": parent, "state": "open"}
        parts["owner"] = f"[{owner}](../tickets/{owner}.md)" if owner else None
        parts["realizes"] = realizes
        if struck:
            stamped = PATH_NOW - timedelta(days=struck[1])
            parts["struck"] = f"{struck[0]}, last {stamped:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ}"
        parts = {name: value for name, value in parts.items() if value is not None}
        self.write(f"{STORE}/{identity}-q.md", entry(identity, words, parts))

    def a_tree(self) -> None:
        self.question("q-0001", "What is this project for?", struck=(5, 1))
        self.question("q-0001.0001", "Who is it for?", parent="q-0001", struck=(2, 2))
        self.question("q-0002", "How is it built?")
        self.question("q-0002.0001", "How are the questions kept?", parent="q-0002",
                      owner="01-0010-questions-kept", realizes='A1 "The question store"')
        self.question("q-0002.0001.0001", "How does a question branch?", parent="q-0002.0001",
                      owner="01-0010.0010-a-question-branches")
        self.question("q-0002.0002", "How is a ticket closed?", parent="q-0002", owner="01-0020-a-ticket-closes")
        self.question("q-0002.0003", "Is the cap right?", parent="q-0002", struck=(0, 30))
        self.question("q-0002.0004", "Does the path read?", parent="q-0002", struck=(3, 20))
        self.question("q-0002.0005", "Is the cap read?", parent="q-0002", owner="01-0030-the-cap-is-read",
                      realizes='A1 "The question store"')
        self.question("q-0002.0006", "What follows a close?", parent="q-0002", owner="01-0040-after-close")
        self.question("q-0003", "What landscape does it evolve in?")
        self.write("docs/tickets/01-0010-questions-kept.md", path_ticket("Questions kept", "In progress", "q-0002.0001"))
        self.write("docs/tickets/01-0010.0010-a-question-branches.md",
                   path_ticket("A question branches", "In progress", "q-0002.0001.0001"))
        self.write("docs/tickets/01-0020-a-ticket-closes.md", path_ticket("A ticket closes", "Ready", "q-0002.0002"))
        self.write("docs/tickets/01-0030-the-cap-is-read.md", path_ticket("The cap is read", "Ready", "q-0002.0005"))
        self.write("docs/tickets/01-0040-after-close.md", path_ticket(
            "After close", "Planned", "q-0002.0006", depends="[A ticket closes](./01-0020-a-ticket-closes.md) (the close)"))
        self.write("docs/product.md", PATH_PRODUCT)

    def under(self, lines: list[str], heading: str) -> list[str]:
        """The lines under one of the path's headings, up to the next line at its depth or less."""
        start = next(index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if line.lstrip().startswith(heading))
        depth = len(lines[start]) - len(lines[start].lstrip())
        rest = lines[start + 1:]
        end = next((index for index, line in enumerate(rest) if len(line) - len(line.lstrip()) <= depth), len(rest))
        return [lines[start], *rest[:end]]

**Срез сделан, кроме рассказа.** Теперь каждая сессия при старте получает путь вместе с остальным, что ей кладёт хук, и агент может его прочесть в любой момент. Дела в нём названы своими заголовками, номера стоят после, для сверки. Сегодня путь говорит, что в работе девять дел при пределе восемь. Ещё он перечисляет три темы, тронутые за неделю и оставшиеся без тикета. Одна из них новая: какие числа скажут, что харнесс даёт. Восемь тестов на путь написаны сначала, красными, теперь зелёные; весь набор зелёный, проверки тоже. Предложение в `/recall`, как рассказывать путь человеку, ждёт голоса, так что тикет остаётся в работе.

Две вещи по дороге, обе исправлены:

- **Мой промах.** Хук при старте сессии звал пробуждение своей дорогой и не передавал время; десять тестов хука упали. Исправлено до коммита.
- **Не мой.** Одна проверка какое-то время падала, потому что другая сессия дописывала запись о хостах и ещё не закончила. Мои правки этих записей не касаются. К концу хода та сессия свою правку закоммитила, и проверка прошла.

**Что за раздел нумерации.** В формате тикета есть раздел о том, как составляется номер: `01-0060.0010-slug`. Он говорит, что средняя часть, позиция, *меняется, когда меняется приоритет*. Он велит давать новому тикету место там, где его будут делать, и втискивать номер между соседями, деля разницу пополам. То есть по замыслу номер означает порядок работы. На деле порядок давно живёт в прозе очереди, и номеров никто не меняет: `.0175` подняли вперёд 14 октября, путь поставили перед ним вчера, оба словами. Формат обещает то, чего никто не делает. Вы сказали почистить; вот как я предлагаю:

🧩 **Proposed rule — [.agents/skills/ticket/TICKET-FORMAT.md](.agents/skills/ticket/TICKET-FORMAT.md) · Numbering**

> - position — its identity, never changed; the order of the work is the queue's.
> - Names are `01-NNNN-slug.md`. A new ticket takes the next free position after its siblings', live and done, stepping by 10; positions stay four digits. Never renumber.

Остальное в разделе не меняется: про детей и про релизы. Уходят «меняется с приоритетом», «деля разницу пополам», «где будет делаться» и «завершённые сохраняют номер», которое покрыто словами «никогда не перенумеровывать» (💡 [*Occam*](AGENTS.md:30)).

**Как сессия его получает.** Когда открывается новая сессия, приложение само запускает стартовый крючок харнесса. Тот печатает сводку для агента: кто ещё работает и где, к каким вопросам возвращаются чаще всего, что отложено и пора перечитать. Теперь в конце сводки стоит и путь. Приложение кладёт этот текст агенту в контекст до первого ответа. Вы его не видите, он для агента. Рассказать путь вам должен `/recall`, но правило, как рассказывать, ждёт голоса. До тех пор агент знает путь, а говорит о нём, только если его спросить.

**Какой он сегодня, словами.**

В работе десять дел при пределе восемь. Это теперь включает и сам путь: я перевёл его в работу, когда начал делать. Среди десяти: установка в проект, где уже есть свой метод; выпуски ядра, которые получатель читает до того, как взять; правила, которые знают свой момент; согласие продуктового документа с работой.

За последнюю неделю поднимались три темы, за которые никто не взялся: какими числами сказать, что харнесс даёт; что видит человек, впервые открывший главную страницу; и даёт ли работа с харнессом вообще лучший результат, чем без него.

Готовы к работе пять дел, и у каждого есть причина:

- **Узнать, что каждый хост показывает агенту сам.** От этого зависит, сможет ли хост запрещать то, что запрещают правила.
- **Снять харнесс с проекта одной командой.** Ответа здесь ждут десять временных мест в правилах, больше, чем у любого другого дела.
- **Тесты, которые ловят то, что обещают их названия.** К этому возвращались дважды.
- **Сессия узнаёт, что правила сменились у неё под ногами.**

У меня было так: скилл сам решает, что сказать в свой момент, а голос только как. У вас иначе: скилл производит содержимое, сырой материал, а голос выбирает, что из него сказать и как. Разница в том, кто отбирает. У вас отбирает голос, и это лучше: тогда скиллы вообще не пишут речь. Раздел «что слышит человек» в `/recall` сейчас по сути и есть кусок речи, написанный скиллом, со своими «в их терминах». При вашем делении он становится описанием результата, а говорит голос.

Поэтому скилл помечает в своём результате то, что человек обязан услышать: решение, которое ждёт, сбой, по которому человеку действовать. Всё остальное голос отбирает сам.
