import pathlib

p = sorted(pathlib.Path("docs/questions").glob("q-0037.0009.0021.0002-*.md"))[0]
s = p.read_bytes().decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")

a = s.index("**The shape agreed.**")
b = s.index("\n## Decisions\n")
picture = """**The shape agreed.** The voice is no mechanism. It is one rule of the project's local file,
naming the voice — Lem's here, a voice the model already knows, with no description and no samples —
installed in two places: the entry file's `## Project-local`, read in every turn, for a reply
outside any skill's moment; and, as a group, under `## What the person hears` in every skill that
holds that section, for the moment a skill speaks. What is said at a moment stays the skill's; how,
the voice's; records are not the voice's. Core holds no voice: a tree that writes no such rule has
none, and core says nothing in its place.

**What it stands on.** The installer's group targets, landed with 01-0080: the local file installs a
group row as any rules file does.

**What changes when it lands.** L9 is shrunk to the name and its two clauses that are not the voice;
the fourteen places wrapped as straw dogs bound here are rewritten: the voice phrases in `/harness`,
`/maintain`, `/recall`, `/mechanism`, the align's opening and the entry file go; *A capable reader*
keeps to instructions and records; `/harness`'s `MEETING.md` loses the Lem passage that stands in
core.

**Open here.** Where *A reply speaks the method* — what a reply outside a skill's moment tells —
goes, left where it stands.
"""
s = s[:a] + picture + s[b:]

for marker, note in [
    ("1. The voice is a mechanism of its own:", "1. *(Superseded by 8.)* The voice is a mechanism of its own:"),
    ("7. Being a speaking skill is no new property:", "7. *(Superseded by 8.)* Being a speaking skill is no new property:"),
]:
    assert s.count(marker) == 1, marker
    s = s.replace(marker, note, 1)

case = "\n## The case, 2026-10-24\n"
d8 = """8. The voice is one rule of the project's local file, installed in the entry file's
   `## Project-local` and, as a group, under every `## What the person hears`; no voice mechanism, no
   setting, no kind of output pairing a mechanism with its skill's section. Decisions 1 and 7 are
   superseded *(the user, 2026-10-25, asking why the plan was so complicated)*. Not: a mechanism —
   its doc, rules file, skill and a setting's grammar for one sentence in one tree; nor decision 7's
   pairing check — it guarded a membership the heading already declares.
"""
assert s.count(case) == 1
s = s.replace(case, d8 + case, 1)
p.write_bytes(s.encode("utf-8"))
print("question amended")

# The voice speaks every skill that speaks — implementation plan

- **record of** what it intends to become

**Authored:** 2026-10-25
**Last amended:** 2026-10-25

Implements [01-0016.0030](../tickets/01-0016.0030-the-voice-speaks-every-skill-that-speaks.md): the
voice as one rule of the local file, installed in the entry file and as a group under every
`## What the person hears`; the fourteen straw dogs bound to q-0037.0009.0021.0002 rewritten so core
holds no voice and contradicts none.

**Planning state:** authored 2026-10-25 as a voice mechanism — its doc, rules file, skill, a fifth
output kind *said* and a pairing check — and amended the same day when the person asked why it was
so complicated: decision 8 of the question replaced the mechanism with one local rule. Validated
twice.

## Governing boundaries

- **A project's own answers live in its local file** and reach a file only as the local block, last
  at its anchor (R7). The voice is such an answer.
- **A rule reaches every file of a group** by a row whose target is a path pattern and whose anchor
  is the heading a member holds ([Installed blocks](../architecture.md#installed-blocks)); the local
  file is a source like any other.
- **A project fact never stands in core** (L10, the leak check): no core text names this tree's
  voice.
- **What is said at a moment is the speaking skill's**; how it is said is the voice's
  (q-0037.0009.0021.0002, decisions 3 and 8).

## Impact

**Must change.**

- `local.rules.md`: L9 shrunk to the name and its two other clauses; its targets `AGENTS.md` and the
  group `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md`; a group row `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` · `## What the person
  hears` in the anchor table; its straw-dog wrapper removed.
- The thirteen other straw dogs bound to the question, rewritten and unwrapped:
  - `AGENTS.md`: *A capable reader* keeps to instructions and records; *in their words* and *in the
    person's words* in *A reply speaks the method* go.
  - the ticket rules file, P10: *in plain words, each of its terms explained* goes, P10 keeping
    what an align opens with; reinstalled into `/align`.
  - `/harness`: *in their language*, *in their terms* go; `MEETING.md`: *in plain words, never a
    table of fragments* and *the way Lem wrote …* go.
  - `/maintain`: *in their terms*; `/recall`: *as they would say it*, *in their terms*, *in simple,
    precise language*; `/mechanism`: *in plain terms* — each goes.
- The installs: `local` and `ticket`; the entry contract's version and its findings line.

**Must verify.** The local block in the entry file and under each of the three sections today —
`/harness`, `/maintain`, `/recall` — and the check green; a fresh install into an empty folder
carries no voice; the speech bench's five moments rerun and judged.

**Hidden edges.**

- **The local block lands last at its anchor** (R7). Under `## What the person hears` no mechanism's
  block stands today, so the local block lands at the section's end, after the skill's own text —
  where the skill's words have been said and the voice then governs them.
- **A recipient's update preserves its local block** (R7); a recipient without a voice rule gets
  none. The group row is this tree's, not core's.

Записано, и по правилу кольца: дефолты открыты сторонним вопросом под вопросом о том, как проекты делят один метод, не теряя своих привычек. Сессия держит голос. В вопросе голоса решение 10: правило голоса это дефолт ядра, а останется ли дефолтом Лем, скажете вы после разговора с новым голосом.

Что в дереве уже есть для дефолтов, чтобы вопрос не начинался с нуля. Локальное правило может назвать правило ядра, которое заменяет: `overrides <механизм>/<id>`. Тогда оба текста встают в файл рядом, ответ проекта последним, с пометкой «заменяет». Чего нет: ни одно правило ядра не помечено как дефолт, и нигде не сказано, уходит ли заменённое правило или остаётся стоять рядом. На это как раз и отвечает новый вопрос.

Для тикета голоса это значит развилку:

- **Делать сейчас для нашего дерева.** L9 с групповой целью, язык в нём, тринадцать мест переписаны. Когда появятся дефолты, правило поднимется в ядро как дефолт, а L9 станет нашим ответом, его заменяющим.
- **Ждать дефолтов,** чтобы правило голоса сразу встало в ядро как дефолт и получатели получили его вместе с языком.

Рекомендую первое. Переписывание тринадцати мест нужно при любом исходе, а наше дерево начнёт говорить голосом уже сейчас. Подъём в ядро потом будет одной правкой. Единственная потеря на это время в том, что получатели остаются без просьбы о языке. Пока ни один из них не обновлялся, она не заметна.
